name: My alloy - fill in from your own creep data / DFT / literature
source: Explain where every number comes from. Omega and b from the lattice parameter (XRD or DFT, project 01); mu0 and dmu/dT from elastic constants (DFT project 01 or ultrasonic measurement); D0v, Qv from tracer-diffusion data or DFT (project 02); n, A from your own creep tests (project 03, global power-law fit).
